items.text: Boss creates a VBot app draft without buying a creation right or spending a credit
items.acceptance: the multipart program flow has no rights or credit gate and accepts all package prices as blank

items.text: One simple form captures app name description cover installer platform and initial version
items.acceptance: the server validates the required text, image type and size, installer type and 95 MB limit

items.text: A package without a selling price remains a nullable draft offer and null must not mean zero baht
items.acceptance: vision7_plans.offer_price is nullable satang, a customer offer must be positive, and the existing vision7_plans.price licensing field remains compatible

items.text: Creating the app, duration plans, cover and first installer release must not leave partial records or orphan files
items.acceptance: a failed multipart create removes the inserted program and every uploaded object

items.text: VBot selling reuses the existing Vision 7 program plan release and key engine rather than creating a second licensing system
items.acceptance: the existing programs endpoint and duration plan codes remain the source of program and key compatibility

items.text: The application installer is free to download while customers pay for usable keys
items.acceptance: the public app-code download returns only an active published release and does not require a license

items.text: One key binds one shop only for V Easy and must not be presented as a rule for every VBot platform
items.acceptance: shop activation and binding queries explicitly require platform_type veasy while the app builder distinguishes Android VBot from V Easy
